The '''BH-7X Custom Hunter''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufactured by the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] named after the [[BH-7X]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]].

==Behind the scenes==
The BH-7X Custom Hunter first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' and can be bought during Bounty Contract Week.<ref name="SWTOR In-Game Events for March">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20190301|text=SWTOR In-Game Events for March}}</ref>
